name: Sol Migizi
location: The Circuit — neon-lit entertainment and vice district, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Sol Migizi is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 34, his expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see him surpass them. He works as a street samurai out of The Circuit, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Sol Migizi agrees on two things: he is worth the fee, and he is terrible company at dinner.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
coping_mechanisms: Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
psychology.secret: Deniz Salazar-Quansah once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "I don't get paid to have opinions about the target. I get paid to make them stop moving."
"Chrome doesn't make you faster. Training makes you faster. Chrome just means you survive learning."
"You want philosophy, hire a professor. You want someone dead by morning, hire me."

story_hooks: Deniz Salazar-Quansah intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
The fixer who handles Deniz Salazar-Quansah's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
A crew member from Deniz Salazar-Quansah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Deniz Salazar-Quansah represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown

physical_description.heritage: Indigenous American (47.3%) forms the foundation with Middle Eastern (33.2%) and South Asian (11.7%) creating a striking triadic blend, with minor Northern European (4.4%) and Southeast Asian (3.4%) contributions. Features reflect this dominant mix — warm olive-bronze skin with subtle golden and amber undertones from the Indigenous and Middle Eastern ancestry, high and prominent cheekbones with slight facial width characteristic of Indigenous genetics, lean jaw with angular definition from Middle Eastern and South Asian structure. Eyes show depth and slight epicanthic shape variation from Southeast Asian genetics. Bone structure speaks to the confluence of multiple continents — strong and economical, built for endurance rather than bulk.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, muscle defined by function rather than bulk. Shoulders broad from years of weapon handling. Core tight. Minimal body fat — the build of someone who treats their body as maintenance equipment.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid. No aesthetic consideration — purely utilitarian.
physical_description.eye_color: Chrome iris rings over dark brown — augmented for thermal and low-light overlay
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-bronze with golden and amber undertones — the result of dominant Indigenous American (47.3%) and Middle Eastern (33.2%) ancestry, with South Asian (11.7%) warmth creating depth and subtle red undertones. Weathered from nocturnal living and sun-scarred hands. Deeper in complexion with a subtle warm glow that suggests equatorial and continental origins.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, defined bone structure reflecting Indigenous American and Middle Eastern ancestry — high, very prominent cheekbones with slight width across the face characteristic of Indigenous genetics, lean angular jaw refined by Middle Eastern structure with South Asian angularity. Skin texture marked by years of environmental exposure. Stubble perpetually two days old. Fine lines around the eyes from years of squinting at sights and scopes. No grooming vanity — functional cleanliness only.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right forearm shows visible smartgun link interface — matte chrome housing with faint LED indicators beneath the skin surface. Chrome iris rings visible in both eyes, catching light with slight metallic sheen. Subdermal interface ports on inner wrists, barely raised beneath scarred skin.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar along left temple, barely visible, running from brow to hairline — old blade work
Burn scar across inner left forearm in an irregular patch — electrical contact, three years old
Tattoo on right collarbone: circuit-board geometric pattern in matte black ink, professional work, Tier 3 quality
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands economically, weight balanced on balls of feet. Moves with precise, minimal motion — every gesture calculated. Hands always visible and loose. Head movements deliberate. Default expression neutral bordering on cold. When focused, entire posture tightens to predatory readiness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 street samurai aesthetic. Black reinforced synth-weave jacket with internal weapon clips and modified pockets. Fitted tactical pants with cargo reinforcement. Steel-toed boots broken in and re-soled twice. No logos or crew insignia — anonymous by design. Worn leather gloves (fingerless right glove to access smartgun interface). Simple titanium-alloy watch, old model, reliable. Everything maintained obsessively.
